snippet.title: CRÊPE MASTER! FIRST ALPHA TRAILER
snippet.description:
Crêpe Master! is a fast and crazy VR combat game where you fight like a magical girl. Become the Crêpe Goddess, smash aliens with your magical pan and cast crêpe-powered spells by striking real magical girl poses with your arms.


CRÊPE MASTER! ALPHA IS LIVE AND FREE TO PLAY : 
https://www.meta.com/fr-fr/experiences/8522131494551592/
